    canhrcolors: CANHR Colors for R and Stata

    Source: R/canhrcolors-package.R
    canhrcolors-package.Rd

    The brand colors of the Center for Alaska Native Health Research (CANHR) for R graphics: the colors as hex codes, 'ggplot2' color and fill scales, and a matching 'ggplot2' theme. A companion Stata graph scheme is available from the package's GitHub repository.
